## Phase 2 change pushed for review

The RC-B repair is up as **[change 1922](https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1922)** — "Scale the snapshot GC watermark to the volume" (commit `f47678757f`, `Change-Id: I73cbd91df101764371175dd36205a75c7793b0ab`).

Local gates before push: held-out oracle GREEN 24/24, exact-defect mutation returns it to RED, `make lint` and `make typecheck` (567 files) green, `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` `new=0 increased=0`, module sizes 432 / 791 under the 800 cap, and the incident's CloudWatch series replayed through `JanitorConfig.from_env()` with the deployed `REBAR_GATE_FREE_WATERMARK_PCT=20` now reclaims at the 82% sample — below the 85% alarm floor — where pre-fix nothing reclaimed anywhere from 69% to 90%.

This ticket stays `in_progress` until the change is `LLM-Review +1` **and** `Verified +1` and merged, per AGENTS.md.
